_doc: File DUY NHAT duoc phep go gia tri cua khach. Moi noi khac mang gia tri thuong hieu deu la file SINH RA tu day - chay `npm run brand:apply` de sinh lai. Xem brand/README.md.

identity.name: Góc Creator
identity.legalName: CÔNG TY TNHH THƯƠNG MẠI & DỊCH VỤ ANLIFE GROUP
identity._doc: nameLead + nameAccent = ten hien o tieu de lon trang chu; phan accent duoc in nghieng mau thuong hieu. De trong ca hai thi dung identity.name.

domains._docUseCustomDomains: false = chay tren .workers.dev. "app" = CHI gan ten mien cho khu vuc thanh vien (appHost), trang ban hang van o .workers.dev - dung khi ten mien ban hang dang co site khac chay. true = gan ca hai, tuc la CHIEM ten mien ban hang khoi Worker dang giu no.

payment._doc: So tai khoan nay di thang vao ma VietQR khach quet de tra tien. Sai mot chu so la tien chay sang tui nguoi khac. Doi xong PHAI quet thu ma QR that va doi chieu voi app ngan hang.
payment.accountName: CONG TY TNHH THUONG MAI & DICH VU ANLIFE GROUP

heroVideo._doc: Video ban hang o trang chu. provider: wistia | youtube | vimeo | stream

confirmVideo._doc: Video huong dan o trang cam on. KHONG tu phat: nguoi vua dien form xong, video tu keu len la giat minh.

funnel._doc: Duong dan va tieu de cua tung trang ban hang. Bo mot trang = xoa dong tuong ung o day (build.mjs va worker deu doc tu day nen khong the lech nhau).

landing.title: Thử thách 21 ngày — Xây thương hiệu cá nhân | Góc Creator

testimonials._doc: Loi chung thuc dang video o trang chu. videoId = ma YouTube; de trong thi hien anh giu cho. CHI dung ten va video cua nguoi that KHI DA XIN PHEP ho.

funnel._docBoCauHoi: true = form dang ky dung bo 8 cau hoi trong worker/src/questions.js va cham diem lead theo do. false = form chi hoi ten/sdt/email (nhu trang ban hang cua Goc Creator) - khong cham diem, va /api/leads KHONG doi answers nua.
funnel._docPages: Trang ban hang do apps/funnel-gc/ dung ra (ban da hoan thien cua anh Thanh), khong phai apps/funnel/ cua template.
funnel._docTrangRieng: true = thuong hieu tu mang trang ban hang cua minh (apps/funnel-gc), khong dung ban thiet ke .dc.html cua template. Bo test se bo qua nhung bai kiem noi dung rieng cua template (funnel.js, VSL Wistia) - nhung VAN kiem trang tra ve 200, dung HTML, va co day du header bao mat.

storage._doc: true = khai binding R2 cho kho anh (phai bat R2 trong dashboard Cloudflare truoc, can phuong thuc thanh toan). false = bo han: hoc vien khong tai anh len duoc (API tra 503 kem loi nhan tu te), moi thu khac chay binh thuong. Doi xong chay brand:apply.
